identified_problem: Czechia's September 2024 floods and recurring summer drought, heat and wildfire risks are increasing the demand for climate adaptation, environmental due diligence and energy-efficiency consulting. climate_exposure: The consultancy's client projects span buildings, industry and infrastructure that are increasingly exposed to flood, wildfire and heat hazards across Czechia.
potential_pain: Clients and regulators now expect climate risk and adaptation inputs in EIA, permitting and EPC work; without high-resolution hazard data, ENVIROS risks losing competitiveness on technical bids.
evidence: Talaix flood, wildfire and heat hazard layers and historical event intelligence for Czech project sites.
relevant_capability: Climate risk intelligence and historical event intelligence
recommended_message: Offer Talaix hazard data and professional climate-risk reports as inputs for environmental due diligence, EPC and adaptation studies.
fit_score: Good fit: an established Czech environmental consultancy with project exposure to flood- and wildfire-affected regions; climate risk data complements its core services.
